ANCS Client Exported Functions

group ANCS_CLIENT_Exported_Functions

Functions

T_CLIENT_ID ancs_add_client(P_FUN_GENERAL_APP_CB app_cb, uint8_t link_num)

Add ANCS client.

Example usage 

void test(void)
{
    ancs_client = ancs_add_client(ancs_client_cb, link_num);
}

Parameters:

  • app_cb -- [in] Callback to notify client read/write/notify/indicate events.

  • link_num -- [in] Initialize link number.

Return values:

  • 0xFF -- Adding client operation is failed.

  • Others -- Client ID.

Returns:

Client ID of the specific client module.

bool ancs_start_discovery(uint8_t conn_id)

Used by application, to start the discovery procedure of ANCS.

Parameters:

conn_id -- [in] Connection ID.

Return values:

  • true -- Sending request operation is successful.

  • false -- Sending request operation is failed.

Returns:

The result of sending request.

bool ancs_get_hdl_cache(uint8_t conn_id, uint16_t *p_hdl_cache, uint8_t len)

Used by application, to get handle cache.

Example usage 

void test(void)
{
    uint16_t hdl_cache[HDL_ANCS_CACHE_LEN];
    bool ret = ancs_get_hdl_cache(conn_id, hdl_cache,
                                 sizeof(uint16_t) * HDL_ANCS_CACHE_LEN);
}

Parameters:

  • conn_id -- [in] Connection ID.

  • p_hdl_cache -- [inout] Pointer of the handle cache table.

  • len -- [in] The length of handle cache table.

Return values:

  • true -- Operation success.

  • false -- Operation failure.

Returns:

Operation result.

bool ancs_set_hdl_cache(uint8_t conn_id, uint16_t *p_hdl_cache, uint8_t len)

Used by application, to set handle cache.

Example usage 

void test(void)
{
    ......
    if (app_srvs_table.srv_found_flags & APP_DISCOV_ANCS_FLAG)
    {
        ancs_set_hdl_cache(conn_id, app_srvs_table.ancs_hdl_cache, sizeof(uint16_t) * HDL_ANCS_CACHE_LEN);
    }
    ......
}

Parameters:

  • conn_id -- [in] Connection ID.

  • p_hdl_cache -- [in] Pointer of the handle cache table.

  • len -- [in] The length of handle cache table.

Return values:

  • true -- Operation success.

  • false -- Operation failure.

Returns:

Operation result.
